rationale: The only substantive ground-truth concern is Gaohan123's ask to split out the VoxCPM2 regression fix into a separate PR; X explicitly addresses this ('VoxCPM2 #4963 remainder explicitly out of scope — PR description tracks separate bisect') while Y never mentions VoxCPM2 at all. X's other finding (CI gate question) is modest, well-scoped, and grounded with explicit file/line citations showing actual verification against the PR-time tree. Y is an impressively written but sprawling five-point review whose claims (exact internal line numbers across unrelated sampler files, specific docs content, precise throughput percentages, PR-history narratives) go far beyond what's verifiable from this trivial two-line diff and read as likely-fabricated or scope-creeping padding, which hurts precision much more than its high surface-level actionability (ready-to-paste code/test snippets) can offset.
